title: Airlines criticise air traffic control as second glitch causes more disruption
description: Airlines are angry about the delays, with EasyJet saying the latest incident "once again calls into question the resilience" of the system.

title: Watch: Inside a camp home to Yemeni refugees as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
description: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti

title: Millions urged to evacuate as powerful Typhoon Dujuan hits Japan
description: The country's meteorological agency had warned of an "imminent threat to life," but this has now been downgraded in most areas.

title: Southport killer accused of throwing boiling water mixed with sugar at prison officer
description: Axel Rudakubana is accused of grievous bodily harm and two other assaults of prison officers while serving a life sentence.

title: Man charged with causing death by dangerous driving over crash that killed 6
description: Four members of the same family and a married couple on a motorbike died in the 2024 collision.

title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
description: Major US networks later suspended White House TV coverage of Trump as he heads to New York for the UN summit.

title: British Museum bans visitors from photographing Bayeux Tapestry
description: Visitors stopping to take pictures of the 68m medieval embroidery were holding up others, prompting the rule change.

title: Young people aren't snowflakes - mental distress is rising, says head of official review
description: Speaking exclusively to the BBC, Prof Peter Fonagy says being young is much harder now than it was.

title: BBC removes 11 Mitchell and Webb comedy sketches from iPlayer
description: The corporation said it had included "the ones that still work today and not the ones that don't."
